summary: Camp 1926, shake cupola cabin 1929, R-6 cab on concrete 1963; cab removed in 1978 per two sources; a hiking guide describes tower remains on the summit.

facts.design: R-6 flat cab on a 10-foot concrete base (from 1963)
facts.status_note: The cab was removed in 1978 per two sources, but a county list says destroyed in the 1980s. A hiking guide describes remains of an old lookout tower on the summit.

access.note: A hiking guide describes a loop trail that reaches the summit on foot.

visit.trail_note: Loop hike from the Foolhen trailhead, reached by following FR-225 along Slate Creek.

corrections.why: A hiking guide describes the summit as littered with the remains of an old lookout tower. The status 'ruins' means footings or remains only. The cab itself was removed in 1978, so a human should check whether 'ruins' or 'gone' fits best.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Idaho lookout site describes the cab sitting on a 10-foot concrete base; the Shoshone County list calls the concrete a 10-foot first floor. Both describe a cab raised on concrete, which fits the record's two-story kind.

notes_for_editor: Removal date unresolved: 1978 (Idaho Fire Lookouts and firelookout.com) against 'destroyed' in the 1980s (Shoshone County list). Spelling: the record and the lookout sites say Mastadon; the trail guide and map sites say Mastodon. Elevation 5,905 ft (about 1,800 m) in two sources; the record has none. The account rests on one hiking guide dated June 13, 2021, so a recent visit report would help. Access level 'public' is inferred from the guide's trail loop, not from a land manager.
